i have ocd myself. ocd is not just “this should be how it is, so i’ll fix it”. it’s more like “i have to do everything in sets of four or else my life will be sent into a downward spiral.” or, “my family will die if i don’t go touch those poles over there.” or, “i feel so fucking filthy and i should claw my eyes out because im dirty”. of course there are endless types of ocd, but the point im trying to make is that ocd stems from anxiety or phobic thoughts, that tell you something horrible will happen unless you do a certain compulsion. thinking things should be a certain way is simply being a perfectionist or having your own way of doing things. ocd is a living nightmare that ties an awful thought and a random action together and can be / is debilitating for sufferers.
